items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Willie Hightower, the trumpet player, the carnet? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I remember him.

ctx.x: He lived on 6th between Dryden and Barone. I just forget the number. But that old house is sitting there yet. When I passed there many times, I said, that's the house I was calling, nothing's called the other time then.
That's near Willie Hightower's ice cream parlor.
You remember Willie Hightower, the trumpet player, the carnet?
